title: Week Summary: Efficient AI and Model Optimization

concepts.name: Quantization
concepts.description: Reducing numeric precision of model weights or activations to improve speed, memory use, or deployment efficiency.

concepts.name: Pruning
concepts.description: Removing less important model weights, units, or structures to reduce model size or computation.

concepts.name: Knowledge distillation
concepts.description: Training a smaller model to imitate a larger or more expensive model.

concepts.name: Model compression
concepts.description: Techniques that reduce model size or computation while trying to preserve acceptable performance.

concepts.name: Batching
concepts.description: Processing multiple inputs together to improve hardware utilization or throughput.

concepts.name: Caching
concepts.description: Storing resources so they can be reused without fetching or recomputing them every time.

concepts.name: Latency optimization
concepts.description: Reducing the time required for a system to return a prediction or response.

concepts.name: Memory footprint
concepts.description: The amount of memory required to store and run a model or system component.
